headline: Reliance Jio Surges 21% in Mumbai Trading Debut After Landmark IPO
summary: Shares of Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Jio Platforms surged as much as 21% at the open of trading on the Mumbai stock exchange. The rally established Jio as India's second-most valuable firm.
why: Reliance Jio is India's leading telecommunications and digital services provider, holding substantial weight in domestic capital market indexes.

impacts.name: Reliance Jio Platforms
impacts.why: High investor demand at market debut drove Jio's shares up by as much as 21%.

why_moved: Reliance Jio shares climbed up to 21% upon listing on the Mumbai exchange following its landmark IPO.
